text:
Mei (Finance): Heads up 44 PartnerX April Azure marketplace invoice shows a large rebate line that looks wrong. Partner says it exceeds the contracted tier. Can someone confirm?
Diego (Channel Sales): Which invoice? PartnerX had negotiated tier B (10% cap) for first 6 months, afaik.
Mei (Finance): Invoice INV-2026-04-11, line rebate id REBATE-APR-AZ-2026-XY. Screenshot/CSV snippet below.
Omar (Billing): Pulling it now.
Omar (Billing): raw CSV export:
```
invoice_id,sku,partner_id,gross_charge,rebate,net_charge,rebate_code
INV-2026-04-11,redwood.azure.gen.large,PART-452,45000,9000,36000,REBATE-APR-AZ-2026-XY
INV-2026-04-11,redwood.azure.reserved,PART-452,10000,2000,8000,REBATE-APR-AZ-2026-XY
```
Omar (Billing): Rebates total 11k -> ~20% effective rebate on consumption lines.
Nina (PartnerOps): We have PartnerX mapped to tier B (10%) in partner_tiers table. If 20% applied then something in the rebate engine doubled the multiplier.
AccountingBot: Rule MATCH_REBATE_BY_PARTNER matched partner_id PART-452 and applied percentage 0.10. Another rule OVERRIDE_PROMO_APRIL applied 0.10. Both rules stacking produced 0.20.
Diego (Channel Sales): Oh that stacking was supposed to be prevented by exclusion logic. @Omar can we see the rule execution logs?
Omar (Billing): Pasting log excerpt:
```
[2026-04-11T02:31:02Z] apply_rebate(partner=PART-452, rule=MATCH_REBATE_BY_PARTNER, pct=0.10)
[2026-04-11T02:31:02Z] apply_rebate(partner=PART-452, rule=OVERRIDE_PROMO_APRIL, pct=0.10)
[2026-04-11T02:31:02Z] final_rebate_pct=0.20
```
Omar (Billing): Looks like exclusion condition failed because partner tag 'promo_exempt' missing.
Mei (Finance): Impact for revenue: reversal required for the excess 5k (we expected 5k cap; actual 11k rebate, excess 6k?) Wait calc: expected rebate should be 10% of gross (45k+10k=55k) -> 5.5k, actual 11k, so excess 5.5k.
Diego (Channel Sales): Partner contract language: "max rebate 10% of monthly marketplace spend; excludes reserved SKUs". We need to remove rebate from reserved line and cap total to 10%.
Nina (PartnerOps): I'll run a partner tag audit now. ETA 1 hour.
Omar (Billing): Proposed actions:
1) Create reversal credit REV-2026-04-11-1 for 5500 reason "rebate stacking error"
2) Recompute invoice and issue INV-2026-04-11-R1
3) Push corrected invoice to partner portal + email template
4) Patch rebate engine to enforce exclusive rules
Mei (Finance): Please include GL notes and whether we need a JE to adjust recognized revenue for April close. Tag accounting.
AccountingBot: Flag: reversal will affect recognized revenue if original revenue was recognized. Please confirm with Revenue Ops.
Diego (Channel Sales): I'll draft the customer communication: short apology, corrected invoice, note we are fixing the engine.
Nina (PartnerOps): Audit result: partner tag 'promo_exempt' was accidentally removed during a data migration on 2026-03-29. Affected partners: PART-452, PART-467. I'll attach CSV.
Mei (Finance): Ok. Omar proceed to queue reversal but hold final send until Accounting confirms JE.
Omar (Billing): Reversal queued REV-2026-04-11-1 amount 5500, status PENDING_APPROVAL.
AccountingBot: Approval required from Finance and Revenue Ops.
Mei (Finance): Approve pending JE details.
Diego (Channel Sales): Approve from Sales side.
Nina (PartnerOps): Pushed tag restore to partner metadata and a rollback test added to migrations.
Omar (Billing): After JE confirmation I'll issue INV-2026-04-11-R1 and update partner portal. Draft email posted here: "Attached corrected invoice INV-2026-04-11-R1. Apologies for the error; net due unchanged once corrected."
Mei (Finance): JE confirmed by Revenue Ops in separate ticket (JE-2026-04-45). AccountingBot: JE posted 2026-04-13.
Omar (Billing): Reversal applied and corrected invoice issued INV-2026-04-11-R1. Partner notified via portal and email.
Diego (Channel Sales): PartnerX responded: "Thanks for quick fix, confirmed reconciled." :white_check_mark: 
Mei (Finance): Closing thread. Please add regression test for rebate engine rule exclusion to the infra backlog.
Nina (PartnerOps): Added and linked to PR #834.
Omar (Billing): All done. Closing.
AccountingBot: Reminder: monitor next billing cycle for PART-467 which was also affected.
